errors.name: ProfileNotFound
errors.description: No account by that DID or handle.

actor.description: The account, by DID or handle.

main.description: How an account shows on knotless: its dev.knotless.profile, field by field over its app.bsky.actor.profile, with its follows as the appview counts them. Optional authentication: with an asker, whether it follows the account.

orgView.description: An organization an account is a member of.

kind.description: Which badge: `upstream`, pulls merged into repositories of other accounts; `second-pair`, pulls of other accounts commented on before they merged; `peacemaker`, pulls landed after the merge queue ejected them for a conflict; `forked-and-fixed`, pulls merged into its repositories from forks of them; `good-company`, pulls the merge queue landed in a batch of five or more; `smooth-landing`, pulls the merge queue landed without ever ejecting them; `bisected`, pulls found by halving a batch that failed; `shipped`, releases published; `stargazer`, stars on its most starred repository; `carry-your-own`, an account on a PDS holding five accounts or fewer; `moved-house`, an account whose DID document named another PDS before; `first-light`, an account here with a repository before knotless 1.0. A kind is never reused for another meaning.

next.description: The count the next tier starts at. Absent at the highest tier.

tier.description: The highest tier its count reached, from 1 to 4. A badge earned once, as `forked-and-fixed`, `bisected`, `carry-your-own`, `moved-house` and `first-light` are, has only the first.

count.description: What the badge counts, as the appview counted it.

badgeView.description: A badge an account earned, at the highest tier its count reached.

bot.description: Whether the account says it is a bot, as its dev.knotless.profile's `bot`. Absent when it is not.

orgs.description: The organizations it is a member of in public, as the appview has indexed them; to the account itself, asking, its hidden memberships too. Absent when none.

avatar.description: The account's picture: from Bluesky's CDN, or, for one its dev.knotless.profile names, from this appview.

badges.description: The badges it earned, in the order knotless shows them, as the appview counts them from what it has indexed: none it could not count again from accounts' records. Absent when none, or when the appview keeps no index.

handle.description: The handle the account claims, when it resolves back to it; else the DID.

viewer.description: What the account asking has to do with it; absent when no one asks.

followsCount.description: How many accounts it follows on knotless, when the appview keeps an index.

organization.description: Whether the account is an organization, keeping a public dev.knotless.org record, as the appview has indexed it. Absent when it is not.

followersCount.description: How many accounts follow it on knotless, when the appview keeps an index.

profileView.description: An account as knotless shows it.

description: How an account shows on knotless.
